name: Orbit Racer
about: A three-lap race in 3D against three computer cars on a closed track. Arrow keys or WASD to drive, Space to brake, C to change the camera.
notes: An example game that comes with KimiLM
prompt: A 3D car race with three.js: a closed track, the player's car with a chase camera, three computer cars that follow the racing line at different skills, three laps, positions, lap times and a best lap record.
